description:
Pre-trade risk check for a proposed trade. Call this BEFORE executing
any trade and treat a "deny" decision as a hard stop.

Evaluated at a fixed Tier 1 ceiling ($5,000 notional). For higher
limits, use `evaluate_trade_paid` (Tier 2, $25,000) which settles an
x402 payment on-chain.

amount.description: Quantity in token units — NOT a pre-computed USD value.

asset.description: Asset symbol, e.g. NVDA, AAPL, TSLA, USDG.

contract_address.description:
Token contract address (0x...). Must match the
official registry address for that symbol, or the trade is
denied as a suspected fake token.

wallet.description: EVM wallet address (0x...) the trade would execute from.

name: evaluate_trade

outputSchema.description: Result of a pre-trade risk check.

audit_seq.description: Monotonic sequence number of this decision.

calculated_notional_usd.description: USD value of the proposed trade.

decision.description: Final verdict. 'deny' is a hard stop.

error.description: If present, no verdict was produced. Treat as a hard stop; do not execute the trade.

guidance.description: Suggested next step accompanying `error`, if any.

price_usd.description: Asset price used for the valuation.

reasons.description: Human-readable reasons. Entries prefixed with 'ADVISORY:' are non-blocking context; all other entries drove the decision.

tier.description: Tier the wallet was evaluated at (1-3).

title: Evaluate Trade (Free)
